text.text: Enterprise class storage system that: Accelerates critical applications to support more concurrent users, speed batch processes, and lower virtual desktop costs with the extreme performance of IBM® FlashCore™ technology Is scalable from 2TB – 57TB and is easily deployed and/or integrated into existing infrastructure Enhances the performance, efficiency, connectivity and reliability of essential enterprise application and solutions Features a 2U form factor, Fibre Channel, InfiniBand, FCoE, and iSCSI interfaces, high availability architecture, hot swappable, low power [~625W nominal], and 155 microsecond latency

graphic.text:
Enterprise class storage system that:
Accelerates critical applications to support more concurrent users, speed batch processes, and lower virtual desktop costs with the extreme performance of IBM® FlashCore™ technology

Is scalable from 2TB – 57TB and is easily deployed and/or integrated into existing infrastructure

Enhances the performance, efficiency, connectivity and reliability of essential enterprise application and solutions

Features a 2U form factor, Fibre Channel, InfiniBand, FCoE, and iSCSI interfaces, high availability architecture, hot swappable, low power [~625W nominal], and 155 microsecond latency

text.text: Extreme Performance with MicroLatency: Enable business to unleash the power of performance, scale, and insight with microsecond response times for applications to drive services and products to market fast. Enterprise Reliability: Durable and reliable designs that use enterprise class flash and patented data protection technology is now combined with advanced storage functionalities to ensure enterprise class data protection. FlashSystem 900 is Kroll Ontrack® certified. Macro Efficiency: Driven by consolidation of hardware and software, deployment speed, efficient use of strategic IT staff, and power and cooling savings.

graphic.text:
Extreme Performance with MicroLatency:
Enable business to unleash the power of performance, scale, and insight with microsecond response times for applications to drive services and products to market fast.

Enterprise Reliability:
Durable and reliable designs that use enterprise class flash and patented data protection technology is now combined with advanced storage functionalities to ensure enterprise class data protection. FlashSystem 900 is Kroll Ontrack® certified.

Macro Efficiency:
Driven by consolidation of hardware and software, deployment speed, efficient use of strategic IT staff, and power and cooling savings.

text.text: IBM FlashCore™ technology refers to the IBM innovations that enable FlashSystem storage to deliver extreme performance, IBM MicroLatency™, enterprise-grade reliability, and a wide range of operational and cost efficiencies. These technologies and innovations are represented in the FlashCore hardware-accelerated architecture, IBM MicroLatency modules, and many other advanced flash management features and capabilities.
